questions.questionText:
A student writes about mass and weight.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: A ship which is floating has mass but no weight.
Mass is a scientific word that means the same as weight.
The mass of an astronaut is the same on the Moon as on the Earth.

solid is placed on a balance and a reading is taken. The solid is then immersed in a liquid in a
measuring cylinder.

value from
value from balance
measuring cylinder

options.text: increase in reading after mass immersion of the solid
increase in reading after weight immersion of the solid
reading after mass immersion of the solid
reading after weight immersion of the solid

melting?

The temperature increases and there is no input of energy.
The temperature remains constant and there is an input of energy.
The temperature remains constant and there is no input of energy.
